paper_title: Direct Searches for Hidden-Photon Dark Matter with the SHUKET Experiment
notes: Hidden photon (dark photon) DM search via dish antenna, 5-6.8 GHz (20.8-28.3 ueV). Wide-band 95% CL limit chi ~ 5e-12 stated in text, roughly flat over mass range. A narrow-band improved search at 6.331525 GHz (~26.4 ueV) yields power limit 2.1e-21 W (vs ~1e-18 W wide-band), corresponding to a substantially deeper chi (~2e-13) but exact value not quoted numerically.
